quest.title: Spike Self-Circulation Report: Abstract
quest.description: Assist the researcher from Sumeru in initializing the Pursina's Spike to clear the dark mud from the mining complex of The Chasm.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: I was just checking the Pursina's Spike. I must say that Liyue's miners are made of stern stuff. Just two of them were enough to transport the Spike here.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: But since the Spike has some very fine moving parts, I need to check if it has been affected while in transit. In theory, though, everything should be fine.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #That's what you said the last time, too, and you nearly got Paimon and {NICKNAME} into deep trouble!

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: *cough* Well, I did also say that there is a difference between theory and reality. However, I made sure to check everything before you came.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: Everything has been prepared, and once initialized and in operation, the Spike will not need any initial elemental energy input to maintain its charging state.

choices.text: Wait, it doesn't need any initial energy?

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Yes. Before, I had to adapt it to Inazuma's environment, and so I modified it such that it could only charge and operate through the use of Electro.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: However, that is not the original operating mode of the Pursina's Spike.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Originally, it was intended to function in this sort of environment. In fact, this dark mud is its power source.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: The mud provides power to the Spike?

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: That's right, and that's why the Spike is perfectly suited to solving this issue.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: If you consider it, this dark mud issue we're having in The Chasm has both "symptom" and "source," both of which must be resolved.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Of these, the "source" is...

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Exactly. As such, we must nip the problem in the bud by sealing the openings in the Ley Lines through which the dark mud is spewing out.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Of course, the sealing of the Ley Lines will not completely solve the problem of the dark mud that has already come out.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: However, the Pursina's Spike has the ability to absorb the energy within the dark mud and decrease its power as a contaminant. This is what we call "fixing the symptoms."

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: This way, the dark mud that has already reached the surface will serve as a power source of the Pursina's Spike, and as the Spike continues operation, it will close the Ley Lines from which the mud is spewing forth.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: As for those monsters who have been affected by mud due to long-term exposure, they will lose the enhancements they get from it and be weakened...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh! That's three birds with one stone!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You know what? This Pursey Spikesy is better than Paimon thought!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It's called Pursina's Spike...

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Pursina's brilliance truly is such that one might almost believe that the Spike was specifically made to solve problems such as these.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: If that guess of mine is true, then this whole process of solving the dark mud problem could serve as valuable experimental data in the future.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Who knows, this research might even allow me to discover some hitherto unknown principles behind how Pursina could affect the Ley Lines using certain devices!

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: This subject has great value, honestly... *sigh* If I could win the Akademiya's Pir Kavikavus Prize with this, that would be wonderful.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: This is a prize that the Akademiya gives out specially to young researchers.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Every year, the sages will go over the research reports sent in and cast votes to select the winner.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: The criteria for winning are that the subject must be groundbreaking, creative, and that the person sending the report must have great potential, and be under 40 years of age.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: All those who have won the Pir Kavikavus Prize while under the age of 40 would go on to win great renown in the Akademiya.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That sounds awesome!

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Well, let's start the Spike up right now. Let's hope it solves our problem.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: #That said, please take note, {NICKNAME}, that while the Pursina's Spike is a very impressive piece of equipment, it is also quite intricate and fragile.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: If it is hit while operating or if it is submerged by dark mud, which can cause fouling, the Spike will turn off automatically to prevent any further damage.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: As such, please beware of the mud and of monsters while you operate the device.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: No, that is just how the problem presents itself. The source is in fact the openings in the Ley Lines through which the mud is spewing out.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: As such, we must use Pursina's Spike to seal the Ley Lines shut. That will solve our root problem.
